Name: Slowlax Farm - adds Munchlax Snorlax Slowpoke Slowbro Slowking
Author: 2sober
Description:
This mod replaces the barn animals:

White Cow  -> Snorlax
Brown Cow -> Munchlax

Pig -> Slowpoke
Goat -> Slowbro
Ostrich ->  Slowking

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.

Works fine with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2529]Pokefy[/url].
You can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to mix pokemon from both mods.

Seems to work OK with Version 1.6.
